question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'expression'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• **succession - **a number of people or things of a similar kind following one after the other.
 
• **expression - **the action of making known one's thoughts or feelings.
 
• **suggestion - **an idea or plan put forward for consideration.
 
• **impression - **an idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone, especially one formed without conscious thought or on the basis of little evidence.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word to show what dance portrays as an artistic form. 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that **expression **is the appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - **Dance as an artistic form of (1) expression is extremely old. Evidence of dance as a (2) creative form is available in ancient literary texts, painting and sculpture. (3) Many of the dance forms trace their roots to the (4) techniques of movement codified in the Natya Shastra (5) compiled by Bharat Muni.*
